title: Require diff hygiene before staged-review credit
failure_signature: The dedicated staged review reached git diff --cached --check, which rejected an extra blank line at EOF in the new runner.
trigger_preconditions: A newly added x1 runner is staged for exact review.
candidate_workaround: Trim only the extra trailing blank line, preserve one final newline, regenerate covered hashes, and restage the exact surface.
recurrence_guard: Run diff hygiene on every new runner before awarding staged-review credit.
rollback: Retain the failed review and do not award path, JSON, privacy, or staged aggregate credit from the attempt.
scope_boundary: Owner-created runner whitespace only; no inherited or user content is changed.
